title: Construct bounded exact scalar records for the selected P104 word
body:
The complete selected PR6030 word now has a literal integer scalar executor between rounded native returns. Five extra fractional bits make every ADD, SCALE and COPY exact. The certificate covers all 22,803 events and gives an explicit four-bit failure witness in the declared independent-return model.

For complex dimension 2^n, initial field norm bound B (a power of two), and final error target B*2^-t, use coarse component precision p=t+10+floor(n/2). The complete native-plus-input absolute-defect coefficient is 1323/2, so final error is at most (1323/2048)*B*2^-t. The prefix coefficient is 2764; ideal-plus-error norm stays below 1024B. Stored signed component records need p+16 bits, and scalar temporaries need p+21. The proof includes initial quantization, every native return and exact owned reset.

This is a completed scalar implementation contract. The native child is not supplied: its entire internal error plus final quantization must meet the declared absolute bound. Exact COPY/reset, tape access, physical placement, native internal precision and the full compiler cost remain open. The five framework assumptions, recursive invoice and selected frontier stay unchanged; no new kappa is claimed. The grid witness is sharp for independent native returns, not a physical optimum for the fixed native maps.

Verification compares every symbolic prefix with an independent fixed-grid integer row, all 799 final error rows with a reverse signed calculation, and 273,636 literal record events with a separate rational interpreter. Complete source endpoint/frame/ownership/invoice checks and four negative controls pass. CPython 3.12.14 normal/optimized registered checks, committed bytes/modes, official export and read-only Git-free/empty-PATH normal/optimized replay pass at `d8f450f1583c4f150b0ed2a8db177453d49c841d`. Hosted CI is pending. The optional full-history preflight was not run in this shallow checkout; all live source files are in the immediate main parent and the cold export.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-exact-scalar-records`.

[Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5600#discussioncomment-19363535). Canonical main, revision 8 and live work were refreshed before submission. This bounded-record construction is separate from the active PR6453 forward-checker speed work. Credit Adam Gall's native-error method; Arham Tahir, Nick Petalas and ywz65's physical-grid work; Nick Petalas's rank-seven grid certificate; DreamingOfClouds/PR6030 and the retained P104/native/compiler lineage. Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.
